events.verdict: Vukcevic (WAS) lowers his left hand down towards the ball and avoids making any illegal contact with Christopher (MIA) during the dunk attempt at the basket.
Anderson (MIA) comes to the space in front of Vukcevic (WAS) and he absorbs the marginal contact as the two players come together at the start of Vukcevic's dribble drive.
Jones (WAS) does not establish himself in a legal guarding position prior to Johnson (MIA) raising his arms up towards the basket and the ensuing contact alters Johnson's layup attempt in the paint.
Johnson (WAS) attempts to firm up in Anderson's (MIA) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Rozier (MIA) momentarily brushes Carrington's (WAS) front during his drive around the perimeter and the contact is marginal.
Anderson (MIA) legally contests Jones' (WAS) jump shot attempt.

Carrington (WAS) lowers his right arm down towards the ball and his forearm makes contact with it, which dislodges it from Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) grasp after his gather. After the ball becomes dislodges, Carrington's arm continues downward and incidental contact occurs with Jaquez Jr.'s shoulder.
Vukcevic (WAS) places and removes his hands from Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) side as he attempts to set a pick and the contact during the play is marginal.
Anderson (MIA) legally contests Carrington's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Carrington (WAS) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) arm after his gather, which impacts his driving shot attempt.
Vukcevic (WAS) establishes himself in Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Vukcevic (WAS) commits a take foul on Christopher (MIA).
Christopher (MIA) legally contests Champagnie's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Christopher (MIA) gathers the pass in the frontcourt and then steps his right foot back onto the midcourt line while in possession of the ball.
Champagnie (WAS) releases his inbound pass prior to five seconds elapsing after receiving the ball from the official.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) grasps and promptly releases Carrington's (WAS) jersey during the inbound play and the contact is marginal.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) moves alongside Carrington's (WAS) path and legally contests Carrington's driving shot attempt.
